Amazon Wholesale Operations Manager Join our dynamic team of e-commerce professionals as an exceptional Operations Manager for a successful Amazon Wholesale Company based in the USA. This full-time remote opportunity allows you to take charge of overall operations and lead a small team to help take our company to the next level.

If you have experience in managing operations, an in-depth understanding of the Amazon Wholesale model, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you! About the company: We champion the principles of innovation, integrity, and teamwork, propelling the advancement of our Amazon wholesale business.

Deeply rooted in our culture, our core values are the compass by which we navigate every decision, ensuring we consistently uphold standards of excellence. With a vision to redefine the e-commerce industry, we emphasize quality, accountability, and leadership. Responsibilities: - Team Management: Implement strategies to achieve growth targets.

Oversee and manage a compact, efficient team. Oversee processes and make sure tasks are distributed efficiently. - Product Sourcing: Hunt for products with an ROI greater than 30% 15% Net at the lowest Keepa yearly listing price. Utilize Keepa charts and historical data to identify products with high-profit potential.

Engage in reverse sourcing to secure goods at optimized costs. Discard conventional price lists for innovative pricing strategies. - Product Listings Management: Optimize listings with researched keywords, ensuring the descriptions, images, and all elements are up to Amazon's top-tier standards.

Monitoring and fixing backend health pictures, description, oz. - Inventory & Suppliers Management: Manage inventory to prevent overstock or stock-outs, aligning with sales predictions and market demands. Nurture relationships with suppliers, ensuring steady product supply through negotiated contracts.

Comprehensively understand Amazon's FBA logistics and streamline fulfilment processes. Handle vendor sourcing, relations, and procurement tasks. CRM Implementation and Management - Reporting: Utilize Excel to perform profit and loss calculations. Extract key insights from sales, market trends, and customer behavior using data analytics tools.

Generate insightful reports for strategic decisions. Qualifications: Background in Business Management, Operations, or a relevant field. A minimum of 3 years' experience in the Amazon wholesale model. Proficiency with CRM tools (Vendrive or other) Demonstrated experience in leading end-to-end operations. Managed a compact team effectively.

Proven skills in overseeing inventory, supplier relationships, and logistics. Aptitude to drive efficiency and growth in wholesale distribution. Proficiency with the Keepa tool. What We Offer: Competitive salary commensurate with skills and experience. Full-time role spanning 40 hours a week.

Preference for candidates available during full EST hours. However, a minimum 4-hour overlap with EST will be considered. Performance-based bonuses. Growth and development opportunities. An inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment. Originally posted on Himalayas

At Foxelli Group , we're not just leading the digital marketplace - we're redefining it. With 10 years of experience and a portfolio of thriving direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands generating over $20 million USD annually, we’re pushing boundaries to achieve our next growth milestone.

That’s why we’re on the hunt for an Operations Manager who’s ready to make a real impact. ❕This role is 100% remote, and you will join a team that already works from 20 different world countries. THE ROLE We’re on a mission to make work smarter, faster , and more impactful .

As an Operations Manager , you’ll be at the heart of our efforts to refine internal processes, resolve inefficiencies, and drive impactful improvements in collaboration with our COO.

This role is perfect for someone who loves to uncover and eliminate the root causes of operational challenges, creating systems that empower teams to work at their best. RESPONSIBILITIES Identify and Fix Inefficiencies: Analyze workflows across teams to uncover inefficiencies, gaps, or breakdowns in communication.

Propose and implement solutions to streamline operations and standardize processes.. Optimize Systems: Oversee and maintain our OKRs system, ensuring it reflects up-to-date data. Lead the migration from Excel to the best-fit OKR platform for our company, creating a seamless transition.

Enhance Collaboration: Establish and improve communication flows to ensure teams are aligned and information is not lost or delayed. This includes summarizing key takeaways from managerial meetings, distilling what truly matters, and transforming insights into clear, actionable leaflets to improve internal communication.

Strategic Initiatives: Work closely with the COO to identify non-functional areas, develop action plans, and drive strategic initiatives that enhance company operations. Root Cause Analysis: Dig deep into recurring challenges to uncover and address underlying issues, preventing future roadblocks.

Requirements SKILLS & EXPERIENCE A natural problem-solver is passionate about optimizing business operations and creating impactful change. Hands-on experience in e-commerce business operations or similar roles. Strong skills in process mapping, workflow visualization, and system improvement.

Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, with a talent for asking the right questions, gathering insights, and drawing actionable conclusions. Familiarity with OKRs systems and platforms, with experience in transitioning between tools.

Proficiency in tools like Asana (or similar project management platforms) and Excel for data analysis and reporting. A proactive mindset, ready to take ownership of challenges and deliver long-term solutions. Strong leadership and a collaborative mindset. Results-driven with a focus on measurable outcomes.

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS 10 min online DISC assessment to identify your behavioral style, as we strongly believe in the power of diverse teams. 15-30 min intro e-meet with Foxelli Group CPO to discuss company, role, your experiences, and expectations. 60-90 min e-meet with Foxelli Group board members - CEO, CCO, COO, and CPO to discuss: the vision of the role, your competencies, and technical skills.

Have a both-sided Q&A session. Home Task. Decision & Feedback from us. SALARY €1,500 - €2,500 after taxes, depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience, with the potential for quarterly performance-based bonuses tied to KPIs. ❕Please note that this role requires a self-employment certificate.

PERKS & BENEFITS Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and keeping your physical well-being in check. A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep continuously growing.

Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested . A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like. Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrates you .

Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting for your control of a working day, powered by Hubstaff for transparency and fairness. ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS At Foxelli Group, our team operates primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET), which is UTC+2 and UTC+3 .

We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.

Currently, we are hiring in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Greece, Georgia, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Malta, Slovenia, Serbia, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Hungary, Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and South Africa.

Ready to lead Foxelli’s growth journey? Apply now! By applying for this role, you acknowledge that you have read our privacy notice for job applicants. Originally posted on Himalayas

In this role as a Business Operations Analyst, you will be responsible for: Analyzing various human capital data and information systems for strategic workforce planning, succession planning, organizational structuring and human capital management and identifies methods for improving or enhancing current practices and programs to ensure the workforce is effective in meeting mission objectives; Managing recruitment and staffing activities for EXAMS including drafting and reviewing job analyses, coordinating with OHR, and advising managers on recruitment/selection approaches; Drafting and presenting management analyses and reporting.

Communicating highly complex information to others via face-to-face meetings, telephone, or email; Executing strong written communication skills and utilizing subject matter expert knowledge of human capital management to draft and update procedural and other documents in the work area; Exercising judgment and discretion on matters requiring an acute sense of awareness both organizationally and politically; Maintaining and fostering collaborative relationships within EXAMS and across the agency; and Using Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, PowerBI and other data analytic tools to collect data, generate and analyze data trends, and develop charts, prepare detailed reports, presentations, and data analysis for Division leadership.
Time-in-grade for this announcement is one year at the GS/SK-13 level. Applicants are responsible for confirming all required materials are submitted by the closing date of the announcement.

Please check the How You Will Be Evaluated and Required Documents sections carefully, as missing documents will render the application incomplete and ineligible for review. Qualifying experience may be obtained in the private or public sector.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. All qualification requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENT: SK-14: Applicant must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS/SK-13 level.

Specialized experience includes: Providing advice and guidance to managers related to human resource management, general administrative support (e.g. space management, performance management or records management), contract management, workforce analysis, or conference planning; AND Developing and implementing operational and administrative programs, policies, procedures, and/or initiatives to meet organizational needs and accomplish program objectives.

Communicating and working with diverse stakeholders across all levels within the organization to accomplish program objectives. ACCOMPLISHMENT RECORD COMPETENCIES: Your Accomplishment Record narratives should address the following competencies.

See the How You Will Be Evaluated section below for more information: Competency 1: Program Analysis - Examines and analyzes different types of data to assess the organization or program, or specific issues within the organization or program, and make recommendations.

Competency 2: Research and Analysis of Support Functions - Conducts research on and suggests improvements to program and office support functions. Competency 3: Teamwork and Collaboration - Interacts with internal and external others in a manner that advances SEC goals and objectives.

Competency 4: Workload Management - Effectively prioritizes workload in a way that accommodates unforeseen developments and achieves successful outcomes.

About GENUINE
GENUINE is at the forefront of the social commerce revolution. As a fast-growing TikTok Shop Agency, we don’t just create content—we build high-converting shopping experiences. We operate at the intersection of entertainment and commerce, moving at the speed of a viral trend.
To fuel our next stage of growth, we are looking for a data-driven Finance & Operations Manager who thrives in a high-speed environment.
The Mission
You will be the architect of our financial engine. Your goal is to ensure that as our GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) is strongly growing, our margins remain healthy and our cash flow stays liquid.
You will bridge the gap between TikTok’s backend data, our payouts, and our internal profitability.
Aufgaben

Revenue & Commission Reconciliation: Manage the complex flow of funds from TikTok Shop, including platform fees, affiliate payouts, and client disbursements.
Performance Controlling: Analyze the ROI of creator campaigns and live-stream sessions.
You tell us which creators are profitable and which aren't. Cash Flow & Payout Management: Ensure creators and partners are paid accurately and on time while optimizing our own working capital.
Process Automation: You will help implement and oversee tools that connect TikTok Shop data with our accounting software
Commercial Strategy: Support the leadership team in pricing our services—moving from pure retainers to performance-based models (revenue share).
Qualifikation
Your Profile
Experience: 2-4 years in Finance, Controlling, or Ops. Experience in E-commerce, D2C brands, or Affiliate Marketing is a massive plus.
Data Literacy: You are a Google Sheets/Excel wizard. You don't just see numbers; you see patterns and "leaks" in the funnel.
Agility: You thrive in "organized chaos." A TikTok algorithm change doesn't scare you; you adapt the reporting by EOD.
Tech Savvy: Familiarity with e-commerce backends (Shopify, TikTok Shop Seller Center) and modern fintech tools (Spendesk, Moss, etc.).

What’s In It For You
Front-Row Seats to the Future: Join the #1 TikTok Shop partner in Germany. You won’t just be watching social commerce grow; you’ll be the one building it across Europe for the world’s most iconic brands.
A "Day One" Culture: We move fast. Enjoy an international, high-vibe team environment where your ideas don't get stuck in meetings—they get executed.
Direct Impact, Zero Red Tape: Work in a flat hierarchy where you collaborate directly with seasoned experts and have the autonomy to own your projects.
The Cologne Lifestyle: Our modern HQ is located right in the heart of Cologne, surrounded by the city's best energy (and coffee).
Serious Growth: Whether it’s client management, creative production, or deep-dive e-commerce, you’ll be gaining a toolkit that is currently the most in-demand in the global marketing industry.
Team Spirit: We work hard, but we celebrate even harder with regular team events and an appreciative, open atmosphere.
We are the largest TikTok Shop partner in Europe, and we are looking for someone to help us bridge the gap between creative production and modern e-commerce. If you’re ready to lead the social commerce revolution in Europe, we’re ready for you.

GENUINE is one of Germany's leading TikTok Shop partners with offices in Shanghai, Cologne, Hong Kong, and Berlin. Our team brings more than nine years of experience from the social commerce market in China and Southeast Asia. GENUINE was founded in 2017 by Damian Maib in Shanghai.

There, we helped German brands gain a successful foothold in China and position their products in front of millions of consumers. Since 2025, we have also been active in Europe, assisting leading companies in setting up their TikTok Shops.

Bei Upvest verfolgen wir die Mission, Investieren so einfach zu machen wie Geldausgeben. Upvest befähigt Unternehmen, eine breite Palette an Anlageprodukten anzubieten und ihren Kund:innen ein erstklassiges Erlebnis im Bereich Kapitalmarktinvestments und Altersvorsorge zu ermöglichen. Die Upvest Investment API ist einfach zu integrieren, sodass Fintechs und Finanzinstitute Ressourcen sparen und sich voll auf ihr Kerngeschäft konzentrieren können.
Wir sind stolz darauf, mit Europas führenden Fintechs und Finanzinstituten wie DKB, Revolut, N26 und Raisin zusammenzuarbeiten. Upvest wurde 2017 von Martin Kassing gegründet und vereint heute über 270 talentierte Fachkräfte aus mehr als 70 Nationen.

Upvest wird durch ein Gesamtinvestment von 280 Mio. € von erstklassigen Investoren unterstützt, darunter BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures sowie Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital und Motive.

Unsere jüngste Finanzierungsrunde über 110 Mio. € im März 2026 – angeführt von Sapphire und Tencent – dient als massiver Katalysator für unser Wachstum und ermöglicht es uns, ein erstklassiges Investment-Erlebnis zu bieten.
Revolutioniere die Altersvorsorge in Deutschland
Wir suchen einen Junior Operations Manager (f/m/d) rund um das Thema Altersvorsorgedepot, der die operativen Prozesse für diesen zentralen Geschäftsbereich durchführt.

Verantwortung und Durchführung von Übertragungen, Zulagenmanagement, Bonusanträgen sowie der steuerlichen Abwicklung und dem Edge-Case-Handling unter strikter Einhaltung von SLAs und KPIs.
Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung zum zentralen Fachexperten für alle Themen des operativen Tagesgeschäfts.
Fachliche Unterstützung der Kundenteams bei der Betreuung ihrer Endnutzer sowie Beantwortung komplexer Fragestellungen rund um die Altersvorsorge.
Laufende Optimierung der Arbeitsabläufe durch den gezielten Einsatz von KI, Automatisierungstools und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit.
Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Betriebs sowie proaktive Adressierung von Risiken unter strikter Beachtung gesetzlicher Vorschriften und interner Richtlinien.

Grundlegendes Verständnis der Marktregeln sowie der gängigen Altersvorsorgeprodukte (insbesondere Riester-Rente).
Kenntnisse der rechtlichen Rahmenbedingungen sowie ein grundlegendes Verständnis für den Datenaustausch mit der Zentralen Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen ( ZfA ).
Großes Interesse an der Arbeit mit künstlicher Intelligenz und der aktiven Nutzung von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag.
Zuverlässigkeit und Belastbarkeit auch in Zeiten hohen Arbeitsaufkommens sowie ein gewissenhaftes Terminmanagement.
Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative verbunden mit einer ausgeprägten Teamfähigkeit.

Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung mit tiefem fachlichem Fokus auf die Riester-Rente sowie die damit verbundenen operativen Prozesse.
Fundierte Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse und Prozessoptimierung unter Einsatz von Visualisierungstools sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in SQL, Python oder Workflow-Automatisierung (z. B. n8n).
Praktische Erfahrung im produktiven Umgang mit Large Language Models (wie Claude) oder vergleichbaren KI-gestützten Lösungen.

Arbeit mit Mehrwert: Wir bauen die Infrastruktur, die die Zukunft des Investierens in Europa prägen wird. Unsere Arbeit ist komplex, ambitioniert und sinnstiftend. Du arbeitest mit modernen Technologien und schaffst etwas völlig Neues - ohne Legacy-Systeme, ohne Grenzen.
Wohlbefinden: Erhole dich mit 30 Tagen Jahresurlaub und profitiere von Sport- und Gesundheitsbenefits für einen aktiven Lebensstil. Zusätzlich hast du Zugang zu vertraulichem, professionellem Coaching und kannst bis zu 183 Tage pro Jahr remote aus dem Ausland arbeiten. Nach jeweils vier Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit erhältst du außerdem UpRest, ein voll bezahltes Sabbatical von einem Monat.
Weiterentwicklung: Wachstum liegt in unserer DNA. Jede:r Upvenger verfügt über ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget und die Freiheit, selbst zu entscheiden, wie es eingesetzt wird.
Flexibles Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeite hybrid oder remote aus einem unserer Hubs in Berlin, London oder Tallinn - oder standortunabhängig innerhalb Europas, abhängig von der Rolle. Wir geben dir die Wahl und das Budget, dort zu arbeiten, wo du am produktivsten bist: zu Hause oder im Büro. Du entscheidest.
Vergütung & Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Wir sind überzeugt, dass alle Upvenger zu unserem Erfolg beitragen. Deshalb bieten wir ein wettbewerbsfähiges, überdurchschnittliches Gehalt sowie eine Teilnahme an unserem Mitarbeiter:innen-Beteiligungsprogramm.
Team-Events & Feiern: Nimm an unternehmensweiten Events wie UpFest, Team-Dinners, Offsites oder unserer Holiday Party teil, um dich zu vernetzen und gemeinsame Erfolge zu feiern.
Inklusion: Wir fördern eine Kultur, in der sich alle zugehörig fühlen und entfalten können. Unsere Employee Resource Groups stärken Vielfalt, Inklusion und Vernetzung, zum Beispiel durch Upfem für unsere weiblichen Upvenger oder UpVergent, das Unterstützung für neurodivergente Upvengers und Allies anbietet.

Make it easy for others. Wir vereinfachen Komplexes und handeln stets mit den besten Absichten.
Own the outcome. Wir sind proaktiv, schnell und entscheidungsstark. Dabei zählt für uns Fortschritt mehr als Perfektion.
Rise to the challenge. Wir denken groß und gehen über Grenzen hinaus. Neugier treibt uns an, wir lernen kontinuierlich und feiern Erfolge gemeinsam.
Tell the story. Wir starten mit dem Warum - ein gemeinsame Mission gibt Richtung. Transparenz und Wissensaustausch helfen uns, andere zu befähigen und zu inspirieren.
Upvest ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir schätzen Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein.

Building the backbone of European trades – together, with modern software and smart AI solutions.
We don’t just develop software – we’re on a mission to give tradespeople and contractors more room to focus on what matters. We do this by providing a practical SaaS solution that works the way they do: fast, efficient, and without unnecessary administrative overhead. Supported by smart AI features exactly where they make a real difference in everyday work.

As a Senior Revenue Operations Manager (f/m/d) you own Process Excellence across the entire customer lifecycle. You design, implement, and govern the cross-functional processes that connect Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Enablement.
You start with the commercial outcome: understanding how a process impacts conversion, retention, efficiency, or revenue before designing the solution. By combining process design, automation, AI, and operational rigor, you ensure our GTM engine scales consistently across markets, reduces friction, and protects conversion from lead generation through renewal and expansion.
RevOps at plancraft is a commercial function, not a service desk. You operate as a strategic GTM partner and use systems, data, automation, and enablement as levers to drive business outcomes. This role is set up with a clear growth path.

Depending on your experience and the impact you demonstrate, it is designed to grow into a Team Lead position for our Operations Managers. We want you to prove operational excellence first, set standards the wider team follows, and grow into leadership from there. For a strong candidate with prior lead exposure, that path can be shorter.

Own and continuously improve cross-functional GTM processes across lead generation, sales, onboarding, activation, retention, renewal, and expansion.
Design, implement, document, and govern scalable process standards that improve efficiency and commercial performance.
Define and standardize lifecycle stages, handoffs, and SLAs across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Enablement.
Monitor process performance, identify conversion leakage, and drive measurable improvements across the customer lifecycle.
Build and maintain AI-powered automations and workflows that eliminate manual work and increase operational leverage.
Lead operational rollouts across Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, Spain, and Italy while adapting processes to local market requirements.
Translate strategic market priorities into scalable execution, including onboarding journeys, workflows, content operations, and tool configurations.
Build and own the GTM Process Library as the single source of truth for process documentation, onboarding, and change management, and set the standards our Operations Managers work to.
Coach our Operations Managers (Sales Ops, CS Ops, Marketing Ops) on process design, automation, and governance, raising the bar for how the team operates.
Own cross-functional process change from design and stakeholder alignment through rollout, adoption, and impact measurement.
Partner closely with Operations Managers to review process design, resolve cross-functional challenges, and establish consistent operating standards.
Enable GTM teams through documentation, training, and process best practices, with a focus on driving lasting behavior change.
Run regular process audits, KPI reviews, and operational health checks as a recurring cadence the team follows, to ensure process integrity and adoption.

4–7 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Operations within a B2B SaaS environment.
Proven experience owning cross-functional GTM processes end-to-end, from design and rollout to governance and optimization.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes, evaluate trade-offs, and build right-sized solutions.
